fact: The Cabinet's Unified Government Complaints System received and logged 195,000 complaints, appeals, requests and enquiries in September 2025, per the Cabinet assistant secretary-general for complaints.

The system routed 153,000 items in September 2025 to competent bodies, 64% to ministries, 22% to governorates and 14% to linked authorities and universities, with the Central Bank overseeing routing to banks.

The monthly report to the Prime Minister gives complaints resolved per ministry and body, for example 15.1 thousand in health and 13.6 thousand at the Interior Ministry, for September and earlier periods.

Egypt's cabinet Unified Government Complaints System takes complaints by hotline 16528, portal, the Fi Khedmetak app and WhatsApp, and received and handled 206,000 complaints, requests and inquiries in May 2026, per the State Information Service.

The document calls the cabinet's Unified Government Complaints System the broadest official channel for complaints across ministries and governorates, with 172,000 of 206,000 May 2026 submissions (83.5 percent) referred to the competent authorities.

Egypt's Cabinet said its unified government complaints system, through the shakwa.eg portal, the Fi Khedmetak app and WhatsApp numbers, received and handled 1.46 million complaints, requests and reports in 2023, 15% more than in 2022.
Egypt's Cabinet said the unified complaints system directed 68% of 2023 complaints to ministries, 21% to governorates, 9% to authorities and 2% to universities, working with all government bodies.
Egypt's Cabinet published a report on the system's 2023 cases and what was done, for example 72,000 of 78,000 building and land encroachment complaints settled with legal action.
